crossRefs.note: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and…
But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to…
For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.
Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.
A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

translations.web: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.
translations.bsb: But it was not long before a cyclone called the Northeaster swept down across the island.
translations.kjv: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.
translations.asv: But after no long time there beat down from it a tempestuous wind, which is called Euraquilo:
